remarks: Absolutely charming four bedroom expanded cape on a desirable cul-de-sac right off South Avenue. Moments to New Canaan's top rated schools, parks and downtown. Fabulous living room with fireplace, great room with morning and afternoon sun, lovely front porch and wonderful three season sunroom off the kitchen and first floor bedroom/office. The second floor boasts a large primary bedroom suite and two additional bedrooms and full bath. The lower level walks out to the yard and has a cozy recreation/play room along with an exercise room and mudroom. A two car garage, spacious yard, plenty of storage, desirable location and an abundance of curb appeal make this a must-see home.
